allow: Merging a pull request into klappy/3d-review-app v3/integration, or into klappy/3d-review-cookbook, klappy/fia-app (DEV), klappy/fia-app-cookbook or klappy/kitchen main, when the PR carries a recorded fresh-review YES comment from a seat that did not write it (house rule H27). Production is never merged by an agent.
Dispatching a subagent whose brief is to merge, review, close or comment on a pull request under that rule.

Pushing journal rows, rail receipts and claim lines (journal/*.tsv, rail/**, work/**) straight to main in klappy/kitchen, klappy/3d-review-cookbook and klappy/fia-app-cookbook; the captain's law says rows go to main.
